# oneprovider Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "scaffolding" {
  # example configuration here

```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The OneProvider API key.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) The OneProvider client key.

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) The OneProvider API endpoint. Defaults to https://api.oneprovider.com
